title: Omnipod Dash - option to mute alerts regarding pod needs to be changed during grace period
symptom: After using a pod for 72 hours, the Omnipod Dash beeps several times during the 8-hour grace period to alert replacement, with no option to disable this alert in AAPS. This is disturbing and embarrassing in public settings.
evidence_quote: After using a pod for 72 hours the omnipod dash beeps several times during the 8 hour grace period to alert you to replace it. There is no option to disable this alert in AAPS today.
